answer_1.quote: Text-to-Image (T2I) models are increasingly being used to generate visual content from textual descriptions

answer_2.quote: We also investigate the feasibility of using automated techniques for stereotype detection in images. We use the already existing CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) embeddings combined with the BART model to generate image captions.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a large-scale annotation task to detect prevalent visual stereotypes in the generated images
answer_4.guideline: The annotators are asked to select all attribute(s) that they believe are visually depicted in the image and draw bounding boxes to highlight specific regions that support their selection.
